hikes.name: Colchuck Lake
hikes.blurb: A steep, rocky climb to a glacier-green lake under Dragontail and Colchuck Peaks.

hikes.name: Aasgard Pass
hikes.blurb: Past Colchuck Lake and straight up a 2,000-foot boulder gully to the edge of the Enchantments' upper basin.

hikes.name: Lake Stuart
hikes.blurb: Up Mountaineer Creek through meadows to a long lake with Mt Stuart's granite face at its head.

hikes.name: Ingalls Pass
hikes.blurb: Up switchbacks to a larch-filled pass facing Mt Stuart, with Lake Ingalls in the basin beyond.

hikes.name: Nada and Snow Lakes
hikes.blurb: The long, hot climb from Icicle Creek to two lake basins on the doorstep of the Enchantments.

hikes.name: Eightmile Lake
hikes.blurb: Through the regrowing 2012 burn to a lake in a granite cirque.

hikes.name: Longs Pass
hikes.blurb: A short, steep pull to a pass that looks straight across Ingalls Creek at Mt Stuart.

hikes.name: Navaho Pass
hikes.blurb: Up Stafford Creek to an open pass of flowers and rock with the Stuart Range in a long line to the north.

hikes.name: Sauer's Mountain
hikes.blurb: Spring balsamroot slopes above Peshastin to a summit looking up the Icicle at the Enchantments.

hikes.name: Saddle Rock
hikes.blurb: A short, steep climb in the Wenatchee foothills to a rock gap over the city and the Columbia.

hikes.name: Lake Ingalls
hikes.blurb: Over a larch-filled pass to a granite lake at the foot of Mt Stuart, mountain goats likely.

hikes.name: Lake Caroline
hikes.blurb: Past Eightmile Lake and up switchbacks to a high lake with Cashmere Mountain and the Stuart Range around it.

hikes.name: Lake Ethel
hikes.blurb: From Lake Ethel Trailhead, a 9.3-mile round trip to Lake Ethel, with about 3,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Ingalls Peak
hikes.blurb: From Esmeralda Trailhead, a 9.1-mile round trip to the top of Ingalls Peak (7,326 ft), with about 3,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Stuart
hikes.blurb: From Esmeralda Trailhead, an 11.1-mile round trip to the top of Mount Stuart (9,326 ft), with about 7,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Cape Horn
hikes.blurb: From Chatter Creek Trailhead, a 12.2-mile round trip to the top of Cape Horn (7,271 ft), with about 5,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Dragontail Peak
hikes.blurb: From Stuart Lake Trailhead, a 12.3-mile round trip to the top of Dragontail Peak (8,813 ft), with about 5,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Navaho Peak
hikes.blurb: From Stafford Creek Trailhead, a 12.8-mile round trip to the top of Navaho Peak (7,200 ft), with about 4,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Annapurna
hikes.blurb: From Stuart Lake Trailhead, a 14.9-mile round trip to the top of Little Annapurna (8,460 ft), with about 6,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Rock Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Snowy Creek Trailhead, an 8.3-mile round trip to the top of Rock Mountain (6,841 ft), with about 3,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bills Peak
hikes.blurb: From Iron Peak Trailhead, a 7.3-mile round trip to the top of Bills Peak (6,150 ft), with about 2,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Teanaway Peak
hikes.blurb: From Iron Peak Trailhead, a 5.2-mile round trip to the top of Teanaway Peak (6,094 ft), with about 2,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Rock Lake
hikes.blurb: From Rock Mountain Trailhead, an 8.0-mile round trip to Rock Lake, with about 3,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lost Lake
hikes.blurb: From Merritt Lake Trailhead, a 7.1-mile round trip to Lost Lake, with about 3,050 feet of climbing.
